yamaa: "1.0"
type: spec
domain: TEST
base: SRC
keys: [ID]
input:
  SRC: src.csv
  DONOR: {path: donor.csv, key: [ID]}
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [ID, V]}
columns:
  - {name: ID, type: str, label: ID, derivation: SRC.ID}
  - name: V
    type: int
    label: V
    derivation:
      source:
        variable: DONOR.V
        filter: "DONOR.F = 'Y'"
        order_by: [DONOR.O]
        keep: first
